Using your whole credit limit can quietly hurt your credit score.

Kevin Trudeau explains one thing credit scoring looks at: how much of your limit you have used. Use all of it and, he says, you lose a lot of points.

His point is that a stronger score comes from using only a small fraction of what is available to you. Most people never hear this.

How much of your credit limit do you tend to use?
